ينتهجون (form VII)
# يَنْتَهِجُونَ (yantahijūna) /jan.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# يُنْتَهَجُونَ (yuntahajūna) /jun.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
